input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 gives only compliance-with-law (5(a)), authority/rights (5(b)), non-infringement (5(c)) and anti-bribery (5(d)) warranties. There is no express warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no repair/replace/refund remedy. The workmanlike standard in Paragraph 1(b) is a bare performance covenant with no stated remedy, and Section 4's "ACCEPTANCE" heading has no acceptance mechanics to fall back on. Because 5(e) puts the express warranties "in lieu of all other warranties, express or implied," the implied warranties of merchantability and fitness are disclaimed while nothing conformance-related replaces them, leaving Clear Capital close to the walk-away "AS IS" position. The redline inserts a conformance warranty (12 months for software deliverables, 90 days for Services), a no-malicious-code warranty, and an at-Contractor's-option re-perform/repair/replace-or-refund remedy, and confirms the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties; the 90/30-day fallback remains available.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the disclaimer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains rights and compliance reps but no warranty that the Services and Works will actually conform to the Specifications, and no remedy if they do not, so we have added a conformance warranty (12 months for software deliverables, 90 days for Services), a no-malicious-code warranty, and a re-perform/repair/refund remedy, and confirmed the disclaimer in 5(e) does not cut it back. If the longer software period is an issue, we can fall back to 90 days for software and 30 days for Services with the same remedies.

ops.text: (f) Contractor represents and warrants to Company that: (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with industry standards; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, each deliverable consisting of software and the Works will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and accompanying documentation, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance the Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of the applicable Statement of Work; and (iii) the Works will not contain any virus, malicious code, back door or other disabling device. For breach of the warranties in clauses (ii) and (iii), Contractor shall, at its option, re-perform the non-conforming Services or repair or replace the non-conforming deliverable or Works, or, if Contractor fails to do so within thirty (30) days of notice, refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Works. The express warranties in this Paragraph 5 are not limited, waived or disclaimed by Paragraph 5(e).
